description:
Amplify copied digits and a homogeneous current-position format clock.

A common strong-format gate writes D/C and the pair (u/C,v/C); their ratio
gives phase+1. A second gate writes u/C times the leading bit. The shared
raw normalization anchor also writes a continuation flag. Eight replaced GLU units,
with one text-only 128-donor repair. No answer labels enter construction.

phase_analysis.target: phase+1; current-position labels only; random independent continuation digits
